title: Sideline Stack Three-Point Look
description: A sideline inbound uses a stack of players along the lane, releasing one at a time to create a clean look at a three-pointer.

content.objective: Release players one at a time from a stack to create a clean three-point look.
content.setup: Three players stack vertically along the lane; the inbounder stands on the sideline.
instructions: The first player in the stack curls out toward the ball as a decoy.
The second player waits a beat, then releases to the three-point line opposite the decoy.
The inbounder reads the defense and delivers to whichever option is actually open.
Reset with the decoy and shooter roles swapped.
coachingPoints: Release in sequence, not all at once, to avoid clogging the same space.
The shooter should be ready to catch and shoot immediately.
Inbounder reads the defense rather than always going to the first option.
commonMistakes: Both players releasing to the same spot and crowding each other.
Rushing the release before the decoy has actually moved the defense.
Forgetting the backup option if the first read isn't there.
content.safety: Keep the inbounding lane clear so the pass has a safe path.
